slides.title: My car is a rolling junk drawer every winter. Finds that tamed it.
A small car trash can
slides.body: Hangs on the seat back. Receipts and wrappers go in, not on the floor.

slides.title: A back-seat organizer
slides.body: Pockets for wipes, gloves and snacks. Kids can reach it too.

slides.title: A collapsible trunk bin
slides.body: Groceries stop rolling around. Folds flat when you don't need it.

slides.title: A boot tray for the floor
slides.body: Slush stays in the tray, not on the mats.

slides.title: A visor pocket
slides.body: Parking slips and sunglasses in one spot you can reach.

slides.title: If the trash has a home, it stops living on the floor.
